# Ahmad Lashkaripour

> Personal research site for Ahmad Lashkaripour, Associate Professor of Economics at Indiana University.
> Main topics: trade policy, tariffs, industrial policy, climate clubs, WTO, trade agreements, markups, scale economies, and quantitative trade models.

## Key entry points
- Research hub: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/Research.html
- About page: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/About.html
- Teaching page: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/Teaching.html

- Industrial Policy: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/topics/industrial-policy.html
- Markups, Scale Economies, and Trade: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/topics/markups-scale-economies-and-trade.html
- Quantitative Trade Models: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/topics/quantitative-trade-models.html
- Tariffs and Retaliation: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/topics/tariffs-and-retaliation.html
- Trade Policy: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/topics/trade-policy.html
- WTO and Trade Agreements: https://alashkar.pages.iu.edu/topics/wto-and-trade-agreements.html
